Job 90402 on controller east failed in the task "Run the execution environment entrypoint". The playbook reported:

    ansible-playbook: error: unrecognized arguments: --private-data-dir

That says the execution environment was invoked the wrong way. Under an AAP container group the job runs as an ansible-runner worker, and the chained entrypoint has to notice that and install the ansible-playbook wrapper. This one does not: it takes the wrong code path and hands the runner args straight to ansible-playbook, which has no --private-data-dir option, so the process exits rc=2 before any play work happens.

Tracing it: the job template resolves to the catalog item sandboxes-gpte.ans-bu-wksp-rhel-90, which the catalog lookup places in the agnosticd/agnosticd-v2 content repository. tools/execution_environments/ee-multicloud-public/entrypoint.sh.

The file that has to change is agnosticd/agnosticd-v2:tools/execution_environments/ee-multicloud-public/entrypoint.sh, which currently ends in a bare `exec ansible-playbook "$@"` with no container-group detection at all.

Root cause category: automation_failure. Confidence: high.
